descriptionKr:
가슴의 너트를 축으로 회전시켜
2번 연속 팔로 힘껏 친다.
상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
むねの　ナットを　じくに　かいてんして
２かい　つづけて　うでを　たたきつける。
あいてを　ひるませる　ことが　ある。
descriptionEn:
The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest,
and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may
also make the target flinch.

descriptionKr:
상대의 공격을
전혀 받지 않는다.
연속으로 쓰면 실패하기 쉽다.
descriptionJp:
あいての　こうげきを
まったく　うけない。
れんぞくで　だすと　しっぱい　しやすい。
descriptionEn:
This move enables the user to protect itself from
all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used
in succession.

descriptionKr:
코어에서 빔을 발사해서 공격한다.
상대가 다이맥스 중이면
데미지가 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
コアから　ビームを　はなって　こうげき。
あいてが　ダイマックス　していると
ダメージは　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.

descriptionKr:
상대의 기술을 끌어모으는
특성이나 기술의 영향을 무시하고
선택한 상대를 공격할 수 있다.
descriptionJp:
あいての　わざを　ひきうける
とくせいや　わざの　えいきょうを　むしして
えらんだ　あいてを　こうげき　できる。
descriptionEn: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

descriptionKr:
지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹고
방어를 크게 올린다.
descriptionJp:
もっている　きのみを　たべて
ぼうぎょを　ぐーんと　あげる。
descriptionEn: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
어느 한쪽이 기절할 때까지
교체할 수 없게 된다. 한쪽의
포켓몬이 없어지면 효과가 사라진다.
descriptionJp:
おたがい　ひんしに　なるまで
こうたいが　できなくなる。　どちらかの
ポケモンが　いなくなると　こうかはきえる。
descriptionEn: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

descriptionKr:
자신의 모든 능력이
올라가지만 교체하거나
도망칠 수 없게 된다.
descriptionJp:
じぶんの　すべての
のうりょくが　あがるが　こうたい　したり
にげることが　できなくなる。
descriptionEn: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

descriptionKr:
끈적끈적한 타르를 날려서
상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
상대는 불꽃이 약점이 된다.
descriptionJp:
ねばねばの　タールを　あびせて
あいての　すばやさを　さげる。
あいては　ほのおが　じゃくてんに　なる。
descriptionEn: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

descriptionKr:
드라꼰으로 2번 공격한다.
상대가 2마리일 때는
각각 1번씩 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
ドラメシヤで　２かい　こうげき。
あいてが　２ひき　いるときは
それぞれに　１かいずつ　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

descriptionKr:
마법가루를 날려서
상대를 에스퍼타입으로 바꾼다.
descriptionJp:
まほうのこなを　あびせて
あいてを　エスパータイプに　へんかさせる。
descriptionEn: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.

descriptionKr:
다과회를 열어서
배틀에 나와 있는 포켓몬이
각각 지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹는다.
descriptionJp:
おちゃかいを　ひらいて
ばにいる　ポケモンが　それぞれ
もっている　きのみを　たべる。
descriptionEn: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

descriptionKr:
상대를 도망칠 수 없게 한다.
굳히기에 당한 상대는 매 턴
방어와 특수방어가 떨어진다.
descriptionJp:
あいてを　にげられなくする。
かためられた　あいては　まいターン
ぼうぎょと　とくぼうが　さがる。
descriptionEn:
The user locks the target in and prevents it from
fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense
and Sp. Def every turn.

descriptionKr:
전기를 두른 부리로 찌른다.
상대보다 먼저 공격하면
기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
でんきを　まとった　くちばしで　さす。
あいてより　さきに　こうげきできると
わざの　いりょくは　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn:
The user stabs the target with its electrified beak.
If the user attacks before the target, the power of this
move is doubled.

descriptionKr:
단단한 아가미로 문다.
상대보다 먼저 공격하면
기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
かたい　エラで　かみつく。
あいてより　さきに　こうげきできると
わざの　いりょくは　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn:
The user rends the target with its hard gills.
If the user attacks before the target, the power of this
move is doubled.

descriptionKr:
이상한 힘으로
서로의 필드 효과를 교체한다.
descriptionJp:
ふしぎな　ちからで
おたがいの　ばの　こうかを　いれかえる。
descriptionEn: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
전기타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 일렉트릭필드로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　でんきタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンのあいだ　エレキフィールドにする。
descriptionEn:
This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for
five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
벌레타입의 공격.
상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　むしタイプの　こうげき。
あいての　とくこうを　さげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
노말타입의 공격.
상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　ノーマルタイプの　こうげき。
あいての　すばやさを　さげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Speed stat.

descriptionKr:
사용할 수 없는 기술입니다.
다시 배우게 할 수 없지만
기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.
descriptionJp:
このわざは　つかえません
おもいだすことが　できなくなりますが
わざを　わすれることを　おすすめします
descriptionEn:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
격투타입의 공격.
같은 편의 공격을 올린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　かくとうタイプの　こうげき。
みかたの　こうげきを　あげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
고스트타입의 공격.
상대의 방어를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　ゴーストタイプの　こうげき。
あいての　ぼうぎょを　さげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
불꽃타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 햇살을 강하게 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　ほのおタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンの　あいだ　ひざしを　つよくする。
descriptionEn:
This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
얼음타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 싸라기눈을 내리게 한다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　こおりタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンの　あいだ　あられを　ふらす。
descriptionEn:
This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
독타입의 공격.
같은 편의 특수공격을 올린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　どくタイプの　こうげき。
みかたの　とくこうを　あげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
물타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 비를 내리게 한다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　みずタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンの　あいだ　あめを　ふらせる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a heavy rain that falls for
five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
페어리타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 미스트필드로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　フェアリータイプの　こうげき。
５ターンのあいだ　ミストフィールドにする。
descriptionEn:
This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for
five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
비행타입의 공격.
같은 편의 스피드를 올린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　ひこうタイプの　こうげき。
みかたの　すばやさを　あげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
드래곤타입의 공격.
상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　ドラゴンタイプの　こうげき。
あいての　こうげきを　さげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
에스퍼타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 사이코필드로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　エスパータイプの　こうげき。
５ターンのあいだ　サイコフィールドにする。
descriptionEn:
This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for
five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
바위타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 날씨를 모래바람으로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　いわタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンの　あいだ　すなあらしにする。
descriptionEn:
This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
땅타입의 공격.
같은 편의 특수방어를 올린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　じめんタイプの　こうげき。
みかたの　とくぼうを　あげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
악타입의 공격.
상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　あくタイプの　こうげき。
あいての　とくぼうを　さげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
풀타입의 공격.
5턴 동안 그래스필드로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　くさタイプの　こうげき。
５ターンのあいだ　グラスフィールドにする。
descriptionEn:
This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for
five turns.

descriptionKr:
다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는
강철타입의 공격.
같은 편의 방어를 올린다.
descriptionJp:
ダイマックスした　ポケモンが
くりだす　はがねタイプの　こうげき。
みかたの　ぼうぎょを　あげる。
descriptionEn:
This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.

descriptionKr:
자신의 HP를 조금 깎아서
모든 능력을 올린다.
descriptionJp:
じぶんの　ＨＰを　すこし　けずって
すべての　のうりょくを　あげる。
descriptionEn: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

descriptionKr:
데코레이션을 해서
상대의 공격과 특수공격을
크게 올린다.
descriptionJp:
かざりつけを　することで
あいての　こうげきと　とくこうを
ぐーんと　あげる。
descriptionEn: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

descriptionKr:
몸을 부딪쳐서 공격한다.
방어가 높을수록
주는 데미지가 올라간다.
descriptionJp:
からだを　ぶつけて　こうげき。
ぼうぎょが　たかいほど
あたえる　ダメージが　ふえる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

descriptionKr:
드럼의 뿌리를 연주로
조종해서 공격하는 것으로
상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
ドラムの　ねっこを　ドラミングで
コントロールして　こうげき　することで
あいての　すばやさを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

descriptionKr:
사용할 수 없는 기술입니다.
다시 배우게 할 수 없지만
기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.
descriptionJp:
このわざは　つかえません
おもいだすことが　できなくなりますが
わざを　わすれることを　おすすめします
descriptionEn:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

descriptionKr:
집게덫으로 붙잡은 뒤
4-5턴 동안
상대를 끼워서 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
トラバサミで　とらえて
４－５ターンの　あいだ
あいてを　はさんで　こうげきする。
descriptionEn:
The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to
five turns.

descriptionKr:
작은 돌을 태운 불꽃의 공으로
상대를 공격한다.
화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
こいしを　もやした　ほのおの　ボールで
あいてを　こうげきする。
やけど　じょうたいに　することが　ある。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

descriptionKr:
거대한 검이 되어 베어버린다.
상대가 다이맥스 중이면
데미지가 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
きょだいな　けんとなり　きりかかる。
あいてが　ダイマックス　していると
ダメージは　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn:
The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target.
This move deals twice the damage if the target
is Dynamaxed.

descriptionKr:
거대한 방패가 되어 부딪친다.
상대가 다이맥스 중이면
데미지가 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
きょだいな　たてとなり　ぶつかる。
あいてが　ダイマックス　していると
ダメージは　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn:
The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into
the target. This move deals twice the damage if the
target is Dynamaxed.

descriptionKr:
볼주머니에 저장해둔 에너지로
공격하고 자신의 스피드를 올린다.
모르페코의 모습에 따라 타입이 바뀐다.
descriptionJp:
ほほぶくろに　ためた　エネルギーで
こうげきし　じぶんの　すばやさを　あげる。
モルペコの　すがたで　タイプが　かわる。
descriptionEn: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

descriptionKr:
날카롭고 뾰족한 가지로
상대를 찔러서 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
するどく　とがった　えだで
あいてを　つついて　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

descriptionKr:
강인한 꼬리를 세차게
휘둘러서 상대를 공격한다.
상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
きょうじんな　しっぽを　はげしく
ふりはらって　あいてを　こうげきする。
あいての　こうげきを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

descriptionKr:
높은 곳에서 사과를 떨어뜨려서
데미지를 준다.
상대의 방어를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
たかいところから　りんごを　おとして
ダメージを　あたえる。
あいての　ぼうぎょを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
기타나 베이스를 쳐서
큰 울림과 강한 진동을
상대에게 전달하여 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
ギターや　ベースを　かきならして
はげしく　ひびく　おおきな　しんどうを
あいてに　あたえて　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

descriptionKr:
새콤한 사과에서 만들어 낸
산성 액체로 공격한다.
상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
すっぱい　りんごから　つくりだした
さんせいの　えきたいで　こうげき。
あいての　とくぼうを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

descriptionKr:
맞으면 기가 꺾여버릴 것 같은
기세로 공격한다.
상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
くらうと　くじけるほどの
いきおいで　こうげき。
あいての　とくこうを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

descriptionKr:
신비한 물을 흩뿌려서
자신과 배틀에 나와 있는
같은 편의 HP를 회복한다.
descriptionJp:
ふしぎな　みずを　ふりまいて
じぶんと　ばにいる
みかたの　ＨＰを　かいふくする。
descriptionEn: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

descriptionKr:
연기를 분출해서
상대를 공격한다.
혼란시킬 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
けむりを　ふんしゅつして
あいてを　こうげき。
こんらん　させることが　ある。
descriptionEn: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

descriptionKr:
굵은 줄기를 휘둘러서 공격한다.
단 자신도 비틀거리기 때문에
다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
descriptionJp:
ふとい　クキを　ふりまわして　こうげき。
ただし　じぶんも　よろめいてしまうため
つぎの　ターンは　うごけなくなる。
descriptionEn:
The user attacks wildly with its thick leek.
The user can’t move on the next turn, because the
force of this move makes it stagger.

descriptionKr:
상대의 공격을 전혀 받지 않는다.
연속으로 쓰면 실패하기 쉽다.
접촉한 상대의 방어를 크게 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
あいての　こうげきを　まったく　うけない。
れんぞくで　だすと　しっぱい　しやすい。
ふれると　ぼうぎょが　がくっと　さがる。
descriptionEn:
This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
고개를 숙이는 척하면서
흐트러진 머리카락으로 찌른다.
공격은 반드시 명중한다.
descriptionJp:
あたまを　さげる　ふりを　しながら
ふりみだした　かみのけを　つきさす。
こうげきは　かならず　めいちゅうする。
descriptionEn: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

descriptionKr:
본래의 모습이 된
무한다이노 최대의 공격.
다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
descriptionJp:
ほんらいの　すがたと　なった
ムゲンダイナ　さいだいの　こうげき。
つぎの　ターンは　うごけなくなる。
descriptionEn:
This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original
form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

descriptionKr:
사이코 파워로 상대를 공격한다.
사이코필드일 때는 위력이 오르며
모든 상대에게 데미지를 준다.
descriptionJp:
サイコパワーで　あいてを　こうげきする。
サイコフィールドの　とき　いりょくが　あがり
すべての　あいてに　ダメージを　あたえる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

descriptionKr:
필드를 파괴하면서 공격한다.
필드가 어떤 상태로든 변해 있지 않은 경우
기술은 실패한다.
descriptionJp:
フィールドを　はかい　しながら　こうげき。
なんらかの　フィールドじょうたいに
かわって　いないと　わざは　しっぱいする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

descriptionKr:
비늘을 쏘아서 공격한다.
2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.
스피드가 올라가지만 방어가 떨어진다.
descriptionJp:
ウロコを　うちだして　こうげきする。
２ー５かいの　あいだ　れんぞくで　だす。
すばやさが　あがるが　ぼうぎょが　さがる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
1턴째에 우주의 힘을 모아서
특수공격을 올리고
2턴째에 상대를 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
１ターンめに　うちゅうの　ちからを
あつめることで　とくこうが　あがり
２ターンめに　あいてを　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

descriptionKr:
물리와 특수 중 더 많은 데미지를
줄 수 있는 능력으로 공격한다.
독 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
ぶつりか　とくしゅか　よりおおく　ダメージを
あたえられる　のうりょくで　こうげきする。
どく　じょうたいに　することが　ある。
descriptionEn: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

descriptionKr:
자신의 주위에 있는 모두를
공격하지만 사용하면 기절한다.
미스트필드일 때 위력이 올라간다.
descriptionJp:
じぶんの　まわりに　いる　すべてを
こうげき　するが　つかうと　ひんしになる。
ミストフィールドで　いりょくが　あがる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

descriptionKr:
지면에 미끄러지듯 상대를 공격한다.
그래스필드일 때
반드시 선제공격할 수 있다.
descriptionJp:
じめんを　すべるように　あいてを　こうげき。
グラスフィールドの　とき
かならず　せんせい　こうげき　できる。
descriptionEn: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

descriptionKr:
필드의 힘을 빌려서 공격한다.
사용했을 때의 필드 상태에 따라서
기술 타입과 위력이 바뀐다.
descriptionJp:
フィールドの　ちからを　かりて　こうげき。
つかったときの　フィールドのじょうたいに　よって
わざの　タイプと　いりょくが　かわる。
descriptionEn: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

descriptionKr:
지면에서 올라오는 전격으로 공격한다.
상대가 일렉트릭필드 위에 있을 때
기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
じめんから　たちのぼる　でんげきで　こうげき。
あいてが　エレキフィールドに　いるとき
わざの　いりょくが　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.

descriptionKr:
배후에서 엄습해서 공격한다.
상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
はいごから　はいより　こうげきする。
あいての　とくこうを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

descriptionKr:
질투의 에너지로 상대를 공격한다.
그 턴에 능력이 올라간 포켓몬을
화상 상태로 만든다.
descriptionJp:
しっとの　エネルギーで　あいてを　こうげき。
そのターン　のうりょくが　あがった　ポケモンを
やけどの　じょうたいに　する。
descriptionEn: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

descriptionKr:
상대의 지닌 물건을 조종해서 공격한다.
상대가 도구를 지니고 있지 않으면 실패한다.
descriptionJp:
あいての　もちものを　あやつって　こうげき。
あいてが　どうぐを　もっていない　ばあいは
しっぱい　する。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

descriptionKr:
주위에 있는 모든 것을
강력한 산성 가스로 뒤덮어서
지니고 있는 도구를 녹여버린다.
descriptionJp:
つよい　さんせいの　ガスで
まわりに　いるものを　つつみこみ
もっている　どうぐを　とかしてしまう。
descriptionEn:
The user surrounds everything around it with
highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

descriptionKr:
상대에 대한 울분이 담긴 공격을 한다.
그 턴에 능력이 떨어져 있으면
기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.
descriptionJp:
あいてへの　いらだちを　ぶつけて　こうげき。
そのターンに　のうりょくを　さげられていると
わざの　いりょくが　２ばいに　なる。
descriptionEn: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

descriptionKr:
적절한 지도를 통해서
같은 편 전원의
공격과 방어를 올린다.
descriptionJp:
てきかくな　しどうを　おこなうことで　
みかた　ぜんいんの
こうげきと　ぼうぎょを　あげる。
descriptionEn: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

descriptionKr:
공격한 뒤
굉장한 스피드로 돌아와서
교대 포켓몬과 교체한다.
descriptionJp:
こうげきした　あと
ものすごい　スピードで　もどってきて
ひかえの　ポケモンと　いれかわる。
descriptionEn: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

descriptionKr:
3회 연속으로 킥을 날려
공격한다. 기술이 맞을 때마다
위력이 올라간다.
descriptionJp:
３かい　れんぞくで　キックを　くりだして
こうげきする。　わざが　あたる　たびに
いりょくは　あがる。
descriptionEn: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

descriptionKr:
날개를 상대에게 부딪쳐서
공격한다. 2회 연속으로
데미지를 준다.
descriptionJp:
つばさを　あいてに　ぶつけて
こうげきする。　２かい　れんぞくで
ダメージを　あたえる。
descriptionEn: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

descriptionKr:
뜨겁게 달궈진 모래를
상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다.
화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
あつく　やけた　すなを
あいてに　ぶつけて　こうげきする。
やけど　じょうたいに　することが　ある。
descriptionEn: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

descriptionKr:
정글과 하나가 되어
자신과 배틀에 나와 있는 같은 편의
HP와 모든 상태를 회복한다.
descriptionJp:
ジャングルと　いったいか　して
じぶんと　ばにいる　みかたの
ＨＰと　じょうたいを　かいふくする。
descriptionEn: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

descriptionKr:
악의 태세가 극에 달하여
강렬한 일격을 날린다.
반드시 급소에 맞는다.
descriptionJp:
あくの　かたを　きわめし
きょうれつな　いちげき。
かならず　きゅうしょに　あたる。
descriptionEn: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

descriptionKr:
전기가 흐르는 우리 안에
4-5턴 동안
상대를 가두어 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
ほとばしる　でんきの　おりの　なかに
４ー５ターンの　あいだ
あいてを　とじこめて　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

descriptionKr:
생명력을 파워로 바꿔서 상대를 공격한다.
자신의 HP가 적을수록
기술의 위력이 떨어진다.
descriptionJp:
せいめいりょくを　パワーに　かえ　あいてを
こうげきする。　じぶんの　ＨＰが　すくないほど
わざの　いりょくは　さがる。
descriptionEn: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

descriptionKr:
물의 태세가 극에 달하여
물 흐르듯 3회의 연격을 날린다.
반드시 급소에 맞는다.
descriptionJp:
みずの　かたを　きわめし
ながれるような　３かいの　れんげき。
かならず　きゅうしょに　あたる。
descriptionEn: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

descriptionKr:
두 눈에서 사이코 파워를
발사해서 공격한다.
얼음 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
りょうめから　サイコパワーを
うちだして　こうげきする。
こおり　じょうたいに　することが　ある。
descriptionEn: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

descriptionKr:
분노를 불꽃 같은
오라로 바꿔서 공격한다.
상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
descriptionJp:
いかりを　ほのおの　ような
オーラに　かえて　こうげきする。
あいてを　ひるませる　ことが　ある。
descriptionEn: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

descriptionKr:
눈보라를 두른 얼음의 창을
상대에게 던져서 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
ふぶきを　まとった　こおりの　やりを
あいてに　なげつけて　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

descriptionKr:
번개 같은 움직임으로
상대를 농락하며 킥을 날린다.
상대의 방어를 떨어뜨린다.
descriptionJp:
かみなりの　ような　うごきで
あいてを　ほんろう　しながら　キックする。
あいての　ぼうぎょを　さげる。
descriptionEn: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

descriptionKr:
수많은 작은 영체를
상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다.
descriptionJp:
たくさんの　ちいさな　れいたいを
あいてに　ぶつけて　こうげきする。
descriptionEn: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.
The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.
The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.
The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.
Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.
The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.
The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

descriptionKr:
강력한 사이코 파워로 공격한다.
상대가 마지막으로 사용한 기술의
PP를 3만큼 줄인다.
descriptionJp:
きょうりょくな　サイコパワーで　こうげき。
あいてが　さいごに　つかった　わざの
ＰＰを　３だけ　へらす。
descriptionEn: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.
The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.
The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

descriptionKr:
전신에서 끌어모은 강철을
빔으로 바꿔 세차게 발사한다.
자신도 데미지를 받는다.
descriptionJp:
ぜんしんから　あつめた　はがねを
ビームとして　はげしく　うちだす。
じぶんも　ダメージを　うけてしまう。
descriptionEn: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.
The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.
The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.
The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.
The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.
The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.
The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.
The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.
The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
